title: Prefect Failures by Flow
app: Prefect worker/agent logs via UF; Prefect REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=prefect:api state_type="FAILED" OR state_type="CRASHED"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by flow_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Prefect failures grouped by flow so operators immediately see which specific flows are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Prefect is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Prefect failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical flows.
visualization: Table of flow by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Prefect are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
